votes.motion: Approve four of the six remaining Chapter classification applications, with a note that classifications will not be approved next year if owners do not comply with deadlines and procedures.
votes.quote: boa reviewed the applications and voted to approve four of the applications

votes.motion: Remove the 19.04 acres at 305 Flat Hill Road from Chapter 61A and approve the remaining 78 acres under the Forest Management Plan.
votes.quote: the board reviewed the application and voted to remove the 19.04 acres classified under agricultural/horticultural and approved the remaining 78 acres

votes.motion: Deny the Chapter 61A application for 400 Howard St based on the information Harald Scheid presented (Chris Comeau recused).
votes.quote: after review and discussion, the remaining board members voted to deny the application based on the information harald presented.
the board voted to meet on tuesday, january 8, 2013 at 6:00pm.
